The only safeguard for the doctrine of the Trinity of three Divine persons in the Godhead of the Deity is ignorance, superstition, credulity and an affection for the preacher's embarrassments when asked to explain these conundrums, absurdities, inconsistencies and contradictions. 

When Jesus says, "I know neither the day nor the hour of my coming to judgment nor the end of the world, the Father only knows, as He has kept these things in His own power. I can of myself do nothing, it is my Father who doeth the works. My Father is greater than I, my Father is greater than all." The Trinitarians say that Jesus Christ is speaking here in these instances in His human nature but that in His Divine nature He is omnipotent and knows all things, thus giving to Jesus Christ the lie as a prevaricator in order to bolster up their lame duck, the doctrine of the Trinity, of three distinctive persons in Jesus Christ by saying Christ's Divine nature is the Father; His human nature is the Son; and His glorified nature is the Holy Ghost. All these lies, nonsense, and foolishness

they would place in the mouth of Jesus Christ to hide their ghastly hideousness of three Divine persons in one. 

It is not saving faith to confirm in yourself what another says is true without previous examination or thought as to its truthfulness or consistency unless it is readily seen upon the face of it that it is true or consistent with truth.

If you would have the inward acknowledgement of conscience of that faith which your understanding and knowledge approve, you should shun all evils as sin, and come to the Lord in prayer, praise, adoration, and thanksgiving; and let your worship be that of the heart and of the affections; and if your worship is rightly given, you will receive as much of the spiritual acknowledgement and approval of the Holy Spirit of our Divine Father in confirmation and approbation as your conscience is capable of receiving which comes only to those who are in charity of good works and have their confidence toward God established by a knowledge of the truth which is a living, confiding, glorious faith.

The idea which Trintarians have of three infinite persons in the Godhead of the Deity, and what one infinite person inflicts another infinite person endures, since man sinned against the infinite, his guilt is infinite and that it took an infinite sacrifice to satisfy an infinite penalty; but as man cannot commit an infinite act, he being a finite being has not incurred infinite guilt; and the doctrine of the 

Trinity is contrary to scripture, science and reason; for in heaven they do not think one and say three or say three and think one as the Trinitarians do; and all who overcome this antichrist doctrine, Christ says, "I will make a pillar in the temple of my God."

Anyone coming into heaven and proclaiming there are three Divine persons in the Deity as objects of Divine worship and adoration will not remain in heaven very long, for our Divine Father in heaven, and His Son Jesus Christ, His angels and His saints will not put up with anyone who says one and thinks three or says three and thinks one so that they say just the opposite from what they think; and think just the opposite from what they say; for as soon as they find such a falsifier in heaven the angels of God will lead him over to the devil's toboggan slide and cast him headlong down to hell with all other corrupters of truth and virtue.

He that overcometh! What does Christ mean by he that overcometh? He that overcometh the "Papal Beast," the "Mother of harlots and abominations of the earth," the Roman Catholic Church.

"I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the Sword of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark in their forheads nor in their hands."
